selected.title: Claude API version 2026-10-21 migration audit
selected.summary: Anthropic released API version 2026-10-21 and new SDK major versions. Builders must remove sampling parameters, relocate some content blocks and update renamed response fields before switching.
selected.availability: Available through the Claude API and new SDK major versions. On Amazon Bedrock it is available only for Claude 4.7 and later models.
selected.practical_use: Audit a Messages API request fixture for sampling parameters, assistant document blocks and user citations, then run it against the new version in staging before deploying.

source_review.excerpt: In 2026-10-21, a request that sends temperature, top_p, or top_k returns a 400 error.
source_review.decision: Release notes and the full migration guide reviewed. This episode explains the documented compatibility audit without claiming a live API test.
source_review.availability: API version and SDK releases are available now; Bedrock requires Claude 4.7 or later for this version.

openai.reason: October 21 service-tier controls and October 20 twelve-hour prompt caching need a separate settings and cost evaluation.

anthropic.reason: October 21 API version and SDK releases create an immediate compatibility audit with exact documented 400-error conditions.

google.reason: No official Gemini API entry is newer than the October 13 Gemini 4 Argon release, already covered by episode 2026-10-15-gemini-argon-api.

repositories.reason: Recursive Flint is a strong October 21 open-weight coding-agent artifact, but the roughly 80 GB checkpoint and H200/B300 path require a separate evaluation.

architectures.reason: SPEM is a research-only procedural-memory architecture whose full mechanism and evidence require a dedicated Deep review.

editorial_review.context: builder / builder / daily; Claude API version 2026-10-21; event date 2026-10-21
editorial_review.viewer_question: What must a Claude API builder change and test before adopting version 2026-10-21 or a new SDK major release?
editorial_review.prerequisites: An existing Claude Messages API integration, representative request fixtures and a staging environment.
editorial_review.central_task: Find request shapes that will return 400 errors, update them and run the same fixtures in staging before rollout.
editorial_review.new_capability: A new Claude API version and SDK major versions ship together with a defined migration contract and breaking request changes.
editorial_review.closest_archive_coverage: All 17 episode files checked. Episode 2026-10-09-haiku55-migration covered one model migration, not the platform-wide API version or these request rules.
editorial_review.supported_payoff: A focused checklist for preventing avoidable request failures when upgrading the Claude SDK or version header.
editorial_review.evidence_mode_reason: Documented migration walkthrough; no live Claude API call, SDK install or production reliability test.
editorial_review.alternatives: OpenAI service-tier controls and caching are useful but need cost evaluation. Recursive Flint needs large-artifact review. SPEM is research-only. Google has no newer qualifying API release.
editorial_review.selection_rationale: The strongest verified 24-hour change is shipped, specific, breaking and immediately actionable for builders.
editorial_review.final_verdict: approved after source review: the script teaches exact failure conditions, staging steps, access boundaries and the absence of a live test.
editorial_review.metadata_review: The planned title and description name the exact API version and compatibility task, avoid benchmark claims and keep the episode in the builder path.

playlist_review.reason: The complete episode is a technical migration briefing for builders: exact API version, request contract, staging test and platform limitation.
